objective: Use disclosed referral partners to generate paid transparency-service revenue without upfront spend, abusive promotion, price claims, or autonomous token grants.
eligibleWork: Introduce a crypto team that wants a transparency audit, report setup, or proof dashboard.
Share approved factual SATA service copy with Sponsored/Paid Partnership or token-compensated disclosure when compensation is expected.
Send inbound leads to the published intake form or a recorded evidence channel.

compensationModel.paymentTrigger: Only after the referred customer pays and the receipt is confirmed.
compensationModel.notes: Any SATA token grant must have a max token amount, recipient address, disclosure text, receipt evidence, and Executive Chairman approval before transfer.

requiredPartnerDisclosure: Sponsored/Paid Partnership or token-compensated referral relationship. No price guarantee, no redemption promise, no market-support commitment, and liquidity can be thin and volatile.
requiredEvidenceBeforeCompensation: Proposed referral compensation amount and asset.
Public or private disclosure evidence, depending on channel.
approvalGates: Executive Chairman approves the referral policy before any partner offer is made.
Executive Chairman approves each partner-specific compensation proposal.
Executive Chairman approves any token grant, cash payment, or asset movement.
No referral compensation is recorded as earned until customer payment is confirmed.
partnerReplyTemplate: SATA can consider referral compensation only for legitimate paid service referrals. Any relationship must be disclosed, no price or buyer claims are allowed, and compensation is considered only after a referred customer pays. Send the project, contact path, expected role, requested compensation model, and examples of prior work for chairman review.
nextAction: Submit this policy to Executive Chairman review before offering percentage-based compensation to promoters or referral partners.
boundary: This draft policy does not approve any partner, post, token grant, cash payment, transaction, invoice, or asset movement.
